response: PowerShell<#.SYNOPSISGPT-5.5 管道启停脚本。.DESCRIPTION保存位置： D:\Code\ai-pipeline\gpt55-ctl.ps1支持命令： start - 启动 gpt55-server.js；如果已运行则不重复启动 stop - 停止当前项目的 node 服务和关联浏览器 restart - 停止 node+浏览器，清理 SingletonLock/server.lock/processing，重新启动并等待 ready status - 显示服务状态 clean - 清理 SingletonLock/server.lock/processing tail - 查看最新日志用法： pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\Code\ai-pipeline\gpt55-ctl.ps1 status pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\Code\ai-pipeline\gpt55-ctl.ps1 restart#>[CmdletBinding()]param( [Parameter(Position = 0)] [ValidateSet("start", "stop", "restart", "status", "clean", "tail")] [string]$Command = "status", [string]$ProjectRoot = "D:\Code\ai-pipeline", [string]$ServerScriptName = "gpt55-server.js", [int]$ReadyTimeoutSeconds = 20, # 默认只清理 processing，不清 inbox，避免误删未处理请求。 [switch]$CleanInbox, # 默认只杀当前项目关联的浏览器；加此开关会杀所有 chrome/msedge/chromium。 [switch]$HardKillAllBrowsers)Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -----------------------------# 路径配置# -----------------------------$ProjectRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProjectRoot)$ServerScript = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $ServerScriptName$QueueDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "gpt-queue"$InboxDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "inbox"$ProcessingDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "processing"$OutboxDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "outbox"$FailedDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "failed"$DeadLetterDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "deadletter"$LocksDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "locks"$ServerLock = Join-Path $QueueDir "server.lock"$BrowserProfileDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "browser-profile"$BrowserSingletonLock = Join-Path $BrowserProfileDir "SingletonLock"$RootStatusFile = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "server-status.json"$QueueStatusFile = Join-Path $QueueDir "server-status.json"$LogDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "logs"$CtlLog = Join-Path $LogDir "gpt55-ctl.log"# -----------------------------# 通用函数# -----------------------------function Ensure-Directory { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$Path ) if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Container)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null }}function Write-CtlLog { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$Message, [ValidateSet("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")] [string]$Level = "INFO" ) Ensure-Directory -Path $LogDir $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $CtlLog -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 Write-Host $line}function Assert-Environment { if (-not (Test-Path $ProjectRoot -PathType Container)) { throw "项目目录不存在：$ProjectRoot" } if (-not (Test-Path $ServerScript -PathType Leaf)) { throw "服务脚本不存在：$ServerScript" } $node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $node) { throw "未找到 node，请确认 Node.js 已安装并在 PATH 中。" } Ensure-Directory -Path $QueueDir Ensure-Directory -Path $InboxDir Ensure-Directory -Path $ProcessingDir Ensure-Directory -Path $OutboxDir Ensure-Directory -Path $FailedDir Ensure-Directory -Path $DeadLetterDir Ensure-Directory -Path $LocksDir Ensure-Directory -Path $BrowserProfileDir Ensure-Directory -Path $LogDir}function Resolve-StatusFile { if (Test-Path $RootStatusFile -PathType Leaf) { return $RootStatusFile } if (Test-Path $QueueStatusFile -PathType Leaf) { return $QueueStatusFile } return $RootStatusFile}function Read-ServerStatus { $statusFile = Resolve-StatusFile if (-not (Test-Path $statusFile -PathType Leaf)) { return $null } try { return Get-Content -Path $statusFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Write-CtlLog "读取状态文件失败：$statusFile；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" return $null }}function Remove-StatusFiles { foreach ($file in @($RootStatusFile, $QueueStatusFile)) { if (Test-Path $file -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -Path $file -Force Write-CtlLog "已删除旧状态文件：$file" } catch { Write-CtlLog "删除旧状态文件失败：$file；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } }}function Test-ReadyIdle { param( $Status ) if ($null -eq $Status) { return $false } if (-not $Status.PSObject.Properties["ready"]) { return $false } if (-not $Status.PSObject.Properties["busy"]) { return $false } return (($Status.ready -eq $true) -and ($Status.busy -eq $false))}function Get-ServerProcesses { $escapedScript = [regex]::Escape($ServerScriptName) $escapedRoot = [regex]::Escape($ProjectRoot) return @( Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match $escapedScript -and $_.CommandLine -match $escapedRoot } )}function Get-BrowserProcessesForProfile { $escapedProfile = [regex]::Escape($BrowserProfileDir) return @( Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "chromium.exe") -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match $escapedProfile } )}function Stop-ProcessByCim { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)] $ProcessInfo, [string]$Reason = "" ) try { Write-CtlLog "结束进程：$($ProcessInfo.Name) PID=$($ProcessInfo.ProcessId) $Reason" Stop-Process -Id $ProcessInfo.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-CtlLog "结束进程失败：PID=$($ProcessInfo.ProcessId)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" }}# -----------------------------# 状态查看# -----------------------------function Show-Status { Assert-Environment $statusFile = Resolve-StatusFile $status = Read-ServerStatus $serverProcesses = Get-ServerProcesses $browserProcesses = Get-BrowserProcessesForProfile $inboxCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $InboxDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $processingCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $ProcessingDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $outboxCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $OutboxDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $failedCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $FailedDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $deadCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $DeadLetterDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count Write-Host "" Write-Host "====== GPT-5.5 管道状态 ======" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "项目目录：$ProjectRoot" Write-Host "服务脚本：$ServerScript" Write-Host "状态文件：$statusFile" Write-Host "" Write-Host "进程：" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " gpt55-server.js node 进程数：$($serverProcesses.Count)" foreach ($p in $serverProcesses) { Write-Host " - node PID=$($p.ProcessId)" } Write-Host " browser-profile 浏览器进程数：$($browserProcesses.Count)" foreach ($p in $browserProcesses) { Write-Host " - $($p.Name) PID=$($p.ProcessId)" } Write-Host "" Write-Host "队列：" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " inbox ：$inboxCount" Write-Host " processing ：$processingCount" Write-Host " outbox ：$outboxCount" Write-Host " failed ：$failedCount" Write-Host " deadletter ：$deadCount" Write-Host "" Write-Host "server-status.json：" -ForegroundColor Cyan if ($null -eq $status) { Write-Host " 未找到或无法读取。" -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { $ready = if ($status.PSObject.Properties["ready"]) { $status.ready } else { "missing" } $busy = if ($status.PSObject.Properties["busy"]) { $status.busy } else { "missing" } Write-Host " ready：$ready" Write-Host " busy ：$busy" if ($status.PSObject.Properties["pid"]) { Write-Host " pid ：$($status.pid)" } if ($status.PSObject.Properties["currentRequestId"]) { Write-Host " currentRequestId：$($status.currentRequestId)" } if ($status.PSObject.Properties["updatedAt"]) { Write-Host " updatedAt：$($status.updatedAt)" } if ($status.PSObject.Properties["lastError"] -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$status.lastError)) { Write-Host " lastError：$($status.lastError)" -ForegroundColor Red } } Write-Host "================================" Write-Host "" if (Test-ReadyIdle -Status $status) { return 0 } return 1}# -----------------------------# 清理逻辑# -----------------------------function Clear-StaleState { param( [switch]$RemoveInbox ) Write-CtlLog "开始清理残留状态。" if (Test-Path $BrowserSingletonLock -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -Path $BrowserSingletonLock -Force Write-CtlLog "已删除 SingletonLock：$BrowserSingletonLock" } catch { Write-CtlLog "删除 SingletonLock 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } else { Write-CtlLog "SingletonLock 不存在，跳过。" } if (Test-Path $ServerLock -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -Path $ServerLock -Force Write-CtlLog "已删除 server.lock：$ServerLock" } catch { Write-CtlLog "删除 server.lock 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } else { Write-CtlLog "server.lock 不存在，跳过。" } try { Ensure-Directory -Path $ProcessingDir Get-ChildItem -Path $ProcessingDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop Write-CtlLog "已清空 processing：$ProcessingDir" } catch { Write-CtlLog "清空 processing 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } if ($RemoveInbox) { try { Ensure-Directory -Path $InboxDir Get-ChildItem -Path $InboxDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop Write-CtlLog "已清空 inbox：$InboxDir" } catch { Write-CtlLog "清空 inbox 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } else { Write-CtlLog "未清空 inbox。如需清理，请加 -CleanInbox。" } Remove-StatusFiles Write-CtlLog "残留状态清理完成。"}# -----------------------------# 启停逻辑# -----------------------------function Stop-Server { Assert-Environment Write-CtlLog "开始停止 GPT-5.5 服务。" $serverProcesses = Get-ServerProcesses foreach ($p in $serverProcesses) { Stop-ProcessByCim -ProcessInfo $p -Reason "(gpt55-server.js)" } $browserProcesses = Get-BrowserProcessesForProfile foreach ($p in $browserProcesses) { Stop-ProcessByCim -ProcessInfo $p -Reason "(browser-profile)" } if ($HardKillAllBrowsers) { Write-CtlLog "HardKillAllBrowsers 已启用，将结束所有 chrome/msedge/chromium 进程。" "WARN" $allBrowsers = @(Get-Process -Name chrome, msedge, chromium -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) foreach ($p in $allBrowsers) { try { Write-CtlLog "强制结束浏览器：$($p.ProcessName) PID=$($p.Id)" Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } catch { Write-CtlLog "强制结束浏览器失败：PID=$($p.Id)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } } Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 Write-CtlLog "停止完成。"}function Start-Server { Assert-Environment $running = Get-ServerProcesses if ($running.Count -gt 0) { Write-CtlLog "服务已在运行，不重复启动。" [void](Show-Status) return } $node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction Stop $stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss" $stdoutLog = Join-Path $LogDir "gpt55-server-$stamp.out.log" $stderrLog = Join-Path $LogDir "gpt55-server-$stamp.err.log" Remove-StatusFiles Write-CtlLog "启动服务：node $ServerScriptName" Write-CtlLog "stdout：$stdoutLog" Write-CtlLog "stderr：$stderrLog" $process = Start-Process ` -FilePath $node.Source ` -ArgumentList @($ServerScriptName) ` -WorkingDirectory $ProjectRoot ` -RedirectStandardOutput $stdoutLog ` -RedirectStandardError $stderrLog ` -NoNewWindow ` -PassThru Write-CtlLog "已启动 gpt55-server.js，PID=$($process.Id)" Wait-Ready -Pid $process.Id -StdoutLog $stdoutLog -StderrLog $stderrLog}function Wait-Ready { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)] [int]$Pid, [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$StdoutLog, [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$StderrLog ) $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($ReadyTimeoutSeconds) Write-CtlLog "等待服务 ready=true busy=false，超时 $ReadyTimeoutSeconds 秒。" while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 $proc = Get-Process -Id $Pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $proc) { throw "gpt55-server.js 已退出。请查看日志：$StderrLog" } $status = Read-ServerStatus if (Test-ReadyIdle -Status $status) { Write-CtlLog "服务就绪：ready=true busy=false。" return } } $lastStatus = Read-ServerStatus Write-Host "" Write-Host "启动失败：超时后仍未看到 ready=true busy=false。" -ForegroundColor Red Write-Host "stdout：$StdoutLog" Write-Host "stderr：$StderrLog" if ($null -ne $lastStatus) { Write-Host "" Write-Host "最后状态：" -ForegroundColor Yellow $lastStatus | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 } else { Write-Host "" Write-Host "没有生成 server-status.json。" -ForegroundColor Yellow } throw "服务启动超时。"}function Restart-Server { Assert-Environment Write-CtlLog "开始 restart：杀 node+浏览器 -> 清锁和 processing -> 启动 -> 等待 ready。" Stop-Server Clear-StaleState -RemoveInbox:$CleanInbox Start-Server Write-CtlLog "restart 完成。"}# -----------------------------# 日志查看# -----------------------------function Show-Tail { Assert-Environment $logs = Get-ChildItem -Path $LogDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 if ($logs.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host "没有日志文件：$LogDir" -ForegroundColor Yellow return } Write-Host "最近日志文件：" -ForegroundColor Cyan foreach ($log in $logs) { Write-Host "- $($log.FullName)" } $latest = $logs | Select-Object -First 1 Write-Host "" Write-Host "====== Tail: $($latest.Name) ======" -ForegroundColor Cyan Get-Content -Path $latest.FullName -Tail 80 -Encoding UTF8}# -----------------------------# 主入口# -----------------------------try { switch ($Command) { "status" { $code = Show-Status exit $code } "start" { Start-Server exit 0 } "stop" { Stop-Server exit 0 } "restart" { Restart-Server exit 0 } "clean" { Assert-Environment Clear-StaleState -RemoveInbox:$CleanInbox exit 0 } "tail" { Show-Tail exit 0 } }}catch { Write-CtlLog "命令失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" Write-Host "" Write-Host "命令失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red exit 1}
